description: Autonomous image ad relay. Point at a funnel, walk away. Four legs: concept selection → image concepts → quality gate → image generation.
avatar: [path/to/avatar.md — optional, relay will infer from funnel if absent]

legs.title: Concept Selection
legs.description: Read the funnel and avatar. Select which concepts from the concept library are the best match for this specific person and this offer. Save the selection with reasoning.
acceptanceCriteria: Read the funnel in full — not a skim
Read the avatar file if it exists — if not, infer avatar from funnel copy
Read the concept library — understand all available concepts
Select 8-12 concepts that match this avatar's psychology and this offer's angle
For each selected concept: name it, state WHY it fits this avatar specifically (not generically)
Self-check: does each concept selection reference a specific detail from the funnel or avatar? If any selection is generic ('this concept works for all DTC products'), cut it
Save as [outputDir]/artifacts/L1-concept-selection.md

legs.title: Image Concepts
legs.description: For each selected concept, generate a specific image brief. What does the image show? What is the contradiction? What makes someone pause with no text at all?
acceptanceCriteria: Read L1-concept-selection.md — use only the concepts selected there
For each concept, write one image brief: scene description, what the contradiction is, what emotion or confusion it creates before any text is read

Briefs must be specific — not 'woman looking frustrated' but 'woman pulling a heavy plastic detergent jug out of her car trunk, straining, while her neighbour carries a small flat envelope with one hand'
Self-check: does this brief require reading the ad copy to be interesting? If yes — rewrite it. The image must work alone.
Self-check: is this a stock photo cliché? (smiling person holding product, before/after side-by-side, generic lifestyle shot) If yes — rewrite it.
Save as [outputDir]/artifacts/L2-image-concepts.md

legs.title: Quality Gate
legs.description: Run every image brief through the quality gate. Cut anything that fails. Only what passes gets generated.
acceptanceCriteria: Read L2-image-concepts.md
For EVERY concept, run all three gate checks and write the result explicitly:
Gate 1 — Contradiction check: does this image carry its own contradiction without text? PASS / FAIL
Gate 2 — Pause check: would someone stop scrolling on this image with no copy visible? PASS / FAIL + one sentence why
Gate 3 — Stock check: does this look like a stock photo or a generic lifestyle image? PASS (looks real/native) / FAIL (looks stock)
All three gates must PASS for a concept to proceed
Document every cut with the reason — don't silently drop concepts
Target: at least 6 concepts pass. If fewer than 6 pass, flag it in baton.txt and proceed with what passed.
Save approved concepts only to [outputDir]/artifacts/L3-approved-concepts.md

legs.title: Image Generation
legs.description: Generate the actual images from approved concepts. Save each image to the output directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Read L3-approved-concepts.md — generate images only for concepts that passed all three gates
For each concept: write a precise image generation prompt (scene, lighting, style, aspect ratio 4:5 for feed)
Generate each image using the image generation script at [imageGenerationScript]
Save each image to [outputDir]/images/ with a descriptive filename (concept-name-number.png)
Log each generation: concept name, prompt used, filename saved, any generation issues
Self-check: review each generated image — does it match the approved concept? Note any gaps.
Save generation log to [outputDir]/artifacts/L4-generation-log.md
